text:
maria: Trying to wire up the JS SDK in a Deno Edge function and in Bun. Immediately hit "Cannot find module 'node:crypto'" from one of our built files. Any recommendations for defaults we should ship?

dylan: Which import did you use? If the package resolves to our CJS/node output it'll pull node: specifiers. Deno will choke.

maria: Tiny repro: 
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const c = createClient({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('RW_KEY') });
await c.generate('hi');
```
Deno errors on parse because dist/cjs includes `import 'node:crypto'`. Bun doesn't crash but signatures using crypto.subtle fail.

jia: Root cause: resolver picked the wrong entry in package.json. Solution: publish an ESM edge build with only web APIs and prefer it via `exports` so ESM consumers (Deno/Bun) get the edge build.

pat: Agreed. Example exports map we could add: 
```json
"exports":{
  ".":{
    "import":"./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "require":"./dist/node/index.cjs"
  }
}
```
That will make modern importers select the edge build automatically.

maria: That helps but types are still an issue. Deno TS flags `Property 'subtle' does not exist on type 'typeof globalThis'` for `globalThis.crypto.subtle` unless they add DOM libs. We can't require users to change tsconfig.

dylan: We can ship a small `.d.ts` bundled with the edge build that declares the minimal ambient types, e.g. `declare global { var crypto: Crypto; }` and any small interfaces we rely on. Then point `types`/`exports` at it.

jia: Also runtime differences: Bun's webcrypto shape and fetch streaming semantics differ a bit. We need tolerant adapters: detect available API shapes and normalize (e.g., prefer web ReadableStream, but accept Node/Bun streams).

pat: Sample helper idea:
```js
function normalizeBody(body){
  if (!body) return null;
  if (typeof body.getReader === 'function') return body; // web stream
  if (typeof body.on === 'function') return nodeStreamFrom(body); // node-like
  return body; // fallback
}
```
Use it in streaming code paths.

maria: Also for crypto, fallback detection: `const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle || globalThis.webcrypto?.subtle || nodeSubtleShim;` and graceful warning if we must shim.

dylan: Important: some bundlers will still fall back to `main` (CJS) unless `exports` exists. Add `exports` and validate with `node --trace-resolve` and `deno info`.

jia: For types we should include an `edge.d.ts` that is referenced from the ESM export. Contents small: declare global crypto, declare minimal DOM types we use, and export SDK types as usual. That avoids forcing `lib` flags on downstream TS.

pat: CI wise: add quick smoke jobs that run `deno run` and `bun run` against a tiny script that imports the package and calls `generate` with a stubbed fetch endpoint. Gate those jobs on PRs touching builds.

maria: Quick local workaround for folks now: import the ESM entry directly from the published CDN (if we publish it), or use an import_map mapping `node:crypto` to a deno.std shim. But those are user friction. Better to ship package-level fixes.

dylan: Another small note: streaming tests should exercise both response body types (Web ReadableStream & Node-readable) because Bun can sometimes return a stream-like object that doesn't implement getReader.

jia: We should also add a tiny README section: "Using with Deno/Bun" showing minimal config, and the recommended import_map as a last-resort.

pat: Action items I can take: build an ESM edge output, emit `edge.d.ts` with ambient declarations, add `exports` mapping, and add deno/bun smoke tests in CI. I'll open a draft PR.

maria: Awesome. Please include the failing stack + minimal repro in the PR so reviewers can run it locally. Tag runtime and devex.

ci-bot: Task created: `sdk/edge-esm-exports` -> added checklist items: publish edge build, ship edge.d.ts, add deno-smoke, bun-smoke.

dylan: One last gotcha: make sure source maps and error stacks in edge build are not referencing internal node-only files; that can mislead debuggers in Deno. Strip or rewrite sources in the edge bundle.

maria: Good call. I'll include an example `deno.json` and `bun fig` script in the PR to show minimal smoke commands. Will ping when ready.
